name: Sora
source:
Sora is a wild crow that [url=/c9996]Misuzu[/url] befriends during the Air arc before meeting [url=/c9990]Yukito[/url]. When [url=/c9996]Misuzu[/url] meets him, he is unable to fly due to him only being a baby.
[spoiler]Sora is the reincarnation of [url=/c9990]Yukito[/url] from the Dream arc. After [url=/c9996]Misuzu[/url] passes away, he leaves the Kamio household on a journey to find her.[/spoiler]
